newsitem.title: THAILAND: No liquidity problems at FinOne - BOT.
newsitem.headline: No liquidity problems at FinOne - BOT.

text.p: Bank of Thailand governor Rerngchai Marakanond said on Friday that Finance One Plc, a major finance company, was not facing liquidity problems as rumoured since last week.

He told reporters that the company's overall financial position was still sound. The company and the central bank had last week also denied rumours the firm was facing a liquidity crunch and might not be able to meet payments on its bonds.
Rerngchai said although the company suffered some foreign exchange losses, the magnitude was insignificant. He gave no details.
The company has one outstanding Euro Convertible Debenture of $120 million which is due for redemption in 2001 but the interest rate worth $100,000 was due recently.
Rerngchai said the company would meet the obligations for both.
